    All Packages

    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    org.clafer.alloy
    This package provides the Alloy 6 code of a temporal model, as clafer -m alloy writes it: a port of the Clafer compiler's AlloyLtl generator, with the mapping of the positions in the Alloy code back to the model's constraints.
    org.clafer.alloy.solve
    This package provides the Alloy backend of the solution loop, for temporal models: a port of claferIG that runs Alloy 6.2.0 in the same JVM, finds the traces of a model, reads them from Alloy's XML, and computes unsat cores and their near-misses.
    org.clafer.assertion
    This package provides the assertions of a model: a boolean expression of the AST that every instance should satisfy, with where it is in the source model.
    org.clafer.ast
    This package provides the language for building Clafer AST.
    org.clafer.ast.analysis
    This package provides various analysis and optimizations to perform on the AST.
    org.clafer.ast.compiler
    This package provides a compiler to translate Clafer AST to IR.
    org.clafer.choco
    This package provides extensions to the Choco solver used by the Clafer solvers, such as stop criteria (a time limit) that survive a reset of the search.
    org.clafer.choco.constraint
    This package provides Clafer specific Choco constraints required for efficient solving.
    org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator
    This package provides Clafer specific Choco propagators required for efficient solving.
    org.clafer.choco.search
    This package provides Choco search strategies for set variables that choose the variable and the value at random.
    org.clafer.cli
    This package provides the command-line interface of clafersg, the Clafer solution generator (formerly chocosolver): the main class of clafersg.jar.
    org.clafer.collection
    This package provides various data structures common throughout the project.
    org.clafer.common
    This package provides various utility functions common throughout the project.
    org.clafer.compiler
    This package provides a compiler from AST to Choco including algorithms for solving optimal instances and max unsat.
    org.clafer.domain
    This package provides immutable domains over integers, stored as disjoint ranges, and boolean domains, which the AST and IR analyses use to bound variables before they are compiled to Choco.
    org.clafer.frontend
    This package provides the Java frontend of Clafer: a port of the Clafer compiler that reads .cfr models without the Haskell compiler.
    org.clafer.graph
    This package provides data structure and algorithms for directed graphs.
    org.clafer.ig
    This package provides the solution loop shared by the backends, a port of claferIG's command line: the REPL, the solutions (the instances of a static model from Choco, or the traces of a temporal model from Alloy) and their views.
    org.clafer.instance
    This package provides structure for working with instances.
    org.clafer.ir
    This package provides the IR used as in intermediate language during compilation.
    org.clafer.ir.analysis
    This package provides various analysis and optimizations to perform on the IR.
    org.clafer.ir.analysis.deduction
    This package provides the deductions of the IR optimizer: feasibility-based bounds tightening (FBBT), with one deducer per kind of IR constraint, which narrows the domains of the variables before the IR is compiled to Choco, removes constraints that hold, and coalesces variables that must be equal.
    org.clafer.ir.compiler
    This package provides a compiler to translate IR to Choco.
    org.clafer.javascript
    This package provides classes for building Clafer models and invoking the solver via Javascript.
    org.clafer.lsp
    This package provides clafer-ls, the Clafer language server (LSP), on Eclipse LSP4J: JSON-RPC over stdin and stdout.
    org.clafer.math
    This package provides exact linear algebra over rational numbers: linear functions, equations and systems, and sparse matrices.
    org.clafer.objective
    This package provides classes for building the objective.
    org.clafer.ontology
    This package provides a small knowledge base of is-a and has-a relationships between concepts, with an oracle that answers queries about them.
    org.clafer.scope
    This package provides classes for building and retrieving the scope.
